_comment: Pinned MCP discovery results. These values change rarely, so re-deriving
them on every refresh costs several agent turns and pulls the entire
Account describe into context. The refresh skill reuses these bindings
while still corroborating scope against live connector identity, which is
cheap because the identity calls happen anyway.
Re-verify when verified_on is older than ttl_days, when a pinned field is
rejected by the source, or when the user asks for a forced rediscovery.

_tools_comment: This connector exposes no getUserInfo equivalent. Verify identity with
'SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM User WHERE Email = <requester>' and the org with
salesforce_context_selector returns a FILTERED field list that omits real
fields (it hides OpportunityLineItem.ServiceDate), so never treat its output
as proof a field is absent. Confirm absence with a probe SOQL, or enumerate
custom fields with 'SELECT FIELDS(CUSTOM) FROM <Object> LIMIT 1'.
_line_item_comment: This org's OpportunityLineItem has NO end-date field. Both 'EndDate' and
'Service_End_Date__c' are rejected with INVALID_FIELD, so line items carry a
start date only and the service window end is derived by inference.
Do not add EndDate back to the line-item subquery; it fails the whole query.
_rejected_fields_comment: Append any field API name the source rejects with INVALID_FIELD. A binding
listing a rejected field can never report fresh, even inside its TTL.
known_invalid_fields are names confirmed absent in this org on 2026-08-03;
re-pinning one of them to an active *_field binding fails freshness.
_quote_comment: Verified 2026-08-03 via FIELDS(CUSTOM) on Quote. The previously pinned
'Ruby__StartDate__c' / 'Ruby__EndDate__c' do not exist on Quote in this org.
These windows matter: quote-fallback QuoteLineItems have ServiceDate = null,
so without them a quote-fallback package has no service period at all.

_filter_comment: get_projects name filtering uses filter.projectName. A 'name' key is ignored
and silently returns the unfiltered project list, which looks like a match.
Always pass filter.includeArchive = true so archived projects are searched.
